title: Every persistent entity lives in one D1 database accessed through one facade module
description: The application persists every stateful entity (session records, work items, audit trail, whatever the project's domain model requires) in a single D1 database bound into the Worker under a named binding. One facade module in the source tree is the sole reader of that binding; every other module that touches persistence imports the facade and calls its named domain verbs. The D1 binding is never destructured or re-exported outside the facade module.
rationale: D1 is only available inside the Worker request context; a single facade module is what turns that request-scoped binding into an application-side surface with domain-shaped verbs. Multiple call sites reaching into env for the binding produces a codebase where the shape of the store, the parameter binding discipline, and the event-emission discipline are all diffused across the tree. One facade means one place to test, one place to swap, and one place where the persistence code paths are discoverable.
